pairs.subject: content-drift-and-revision
pairs.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/canonStore.ts:49 Canon hydration replaces the entire in-memory rule list, allowing a stale response to drop a rule saved while the fetch was pending.

techniques.evidence: src/components/layout-lab/canonStore.ts:49 Pipeline artifact hydration is additive, but canon hydration replaces the whole list instead of preserving concurrently added entries.
src/lib/test-gate-runner/drain-lease.ts:88 The lab's drain acquires the batch atomically, but its lease registry has neither heartbeat nor expiry, contrary to the required lifetime guarantees.

src/lib/pipeline-artifacts-db.ts:201 Retention is bounded at 20, but raw JSON comparison archives bookkeeping and key-order changes excluded by the drift fingerprint; archive and trimming also occur before the live-write transaction.

src/components/layout-lab/hooks/useEntityArtifacts.ts:224 Content is compared only when statuses match, so simultaneous status and content changes cannot produce the required independent classification.

src/components/layout-lab/CatalogTree.tsx:74 Entity discard deletes artifacts before deleting the entity, and the endpoint purges revisions and verdicts too; this destroys recoverable content instead of retaining visible orphans.

src/components/layout-lab/steps/ArchetypeStep.tsx:461 Direction stamps are persisted and displayed, but the remounted Produce panel initializes from seed/template defaults rather than the artifact's recorded steer, losing default carry-forward.
